picks.file: Aerial photograph, Ukrainian city of Yekaterinoslav, now called Dnipropetrovs'k 2.jpg
picks.what: Aerial photograph of the city center (SMU Central University Libraries)
picks.why: only period view of the city itself; street grid and a large domed church from the air; mount and wing shadow trimmed

picks.what: Panorama over the city center toward the Dnieper, photograph
picks.why: general rooftop view with the twin towers and a gilded church

gaps: P0–P4: nothing of this city (#1–#6 are Kyiv); P5 view is low resolution (1000 px)
notes: #1–#6 are views of Kyiv filed under the Dnieper. #7 (1918) is an industrial district in snow, less legible than #8. #11 is a factory engraving photographed in a book; #9 a satellite image; #12–#13 apartment blocks and chimneys.
